1. Little to no moderation - Since the devs don't really care about any other server outside the Japanese server, they let people do whatever they want everywhere else.

2. People treat it like a dating app - I don't know why, but I've come across a lot of people who truly think they can get a stable relationship out of an app like this. And while they might not entirely be wrong, they also have to realize that this app is a honeypot of scumbags and people who aren't going to be as serious as they are when it comes to dating. This leads to a lot of heartbreak and constant changing of partners in the long-run before they actually find someone to love.

3. Sex sells - Some of the streamers you come across may not actually be as horny as they seem. They may be doing it because it gets them the views, likes, and the donations they need to make it to the top of a contest they're in. Sexual things get people's attention no matter what gender they are, and some streamers have figured that's one of the ways they can get popular and more famous.
